To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) a semantic ontology of user communications is an effective means of profiling user information needs; (2) a combination of collaborative and content-based recommender algorithms can be used to match user profiles to relevant knowledge items; (3) semantic analysis of free text tags can enhance the accuracy of the matching algorithms; and (4) community tags provide an effective means of contextualising the matching algorithms.
the use of ontologies in the context of recommender systems can provide a useful way of capturing the semantics of user information needs.
the proposed system can effectively recommend relevant information to users based on their information needs, and that the use of community tags enhances the accuracy of the recommendations.

developing a system that supports information delivery to citizens in the smart city, and in doing so we are exploring the use of recommender systems, semantic analysis, and crowd input to enhance the accuracy of the matching.
